verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents its authentication/authorization flows (OAuth2, client-credentials, device flow) and ships an official CLI and MCP server, giving AI-native users multiple documented ways to drive the product programmatically. However, the probe found no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec at standard paths, and the evidence pack lacks explicit mention of the core Management API docs, so machine-readable API discovery is weaker than ideal. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec, explicit Management API reference docs, independent developer corroboration of API-driven automation.
